data.name: Munnu
data.gender_notes: Munnu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Munnu is a popular Hindu name with meanings rooted in the protector and savior archetypes. The name is believed to bring strength, courage, and resilience to the bearer. In Hindu mythology, Munnu is also the name of a god associated with the sun and agriculture. The name Munnu carries the meaning “Protector, Savior” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Munnu usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, savior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Munnu belongs to the Hindi linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Savior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munnu total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
